buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ​ 1) Scope of Supply (Bid price to include all cost components): The firm has to supply the material as per the OFA’s Monitoring Instruction. Inspection shall be carried out at OFA’s premises by representative of ED /OFA 2) Bidder should upload OFA’s Monitoring Instruction duly signed & stamped on it for acceptance along with their offer, failing which offer may be rejected. 3) The bidders should have average annual turnover of ₹68,499/- for the last three FY 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. The bidders should submit documentary evidence in the form of certified audited balance shee ts of relevant periods or a certificate from the charted accountant / cost accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. 4) Commercial Experience Eligibility Criteria – a. The firm should be registered (or) established for the supply of similar items (Alloy/Tool Steel rods/f lats/forgings or rather raw material) in Ordnance Factory Ambarnath or other Ordnance Factories. (OR) b. The firm should have past experience for supply of similar items (Alloy/Tool Steel rods/flats/forging s or rather raw material) in Central Govt./ State Govt. Organization / PSU / Public Listed firms during last 0 7 years ending on the last day of the month immediately preceding the month in which the last date of bid submission falls and submitted executed supply order copy as follows: i. Three completed orders each executed for supply of similar items (Alloy/Tool Steel rods/flats/forgings or rather raw material) where executed value is not less than the amount equal to ₹34, 249.50/- (OR) ii. Two completed orders each executed for supply of similar items (Alloy/Tool Steel rods/flats/forgi ngs or rather raw material) where executed value is not less than the amount equal to ₹45,666.00/- (OR) iii. One completed order executed for supply of similar items (Alloy/Tool Steel rods/flats/forgings or rather raw material) where executed value is not less than the amount equal to ₹79,915.50/-. Firm must submit documents in support of past experience (i.e. PO Copies along with Invoices / CRAC / Acc eptance Certificate in support of experience criteria).

5) The benefits to relaxation in the norms relating to prior experience and prior turnover criteria shall be available to eligible Start-ups and Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs) in accordance with the applicable instr uctions/orders issued by the Ministry of MSME, Government of India, and the provisions applicable on the G eM portal. 6) The benefits of prior experience and prior turnover shall be relaxed for DPIIT-recognized Startups, as per applicable Government of India/GeM provisions, only where the Startup bidder is the actual manufactur er of the Alloy/Tool Steel rods/flats/forgings or rather raw material. 7) The benefits of MSE purchase preference and other applicable MSE benefits such as prior experience and prior turnover criteria shall be available only to actual manufacturer and those bidders who have clai med/applied for MSE benefit on the GeM portal at the time of submission of the bid and who possess a vali d Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) indicating (relevant NIC Code for Alloy/Tool Steel rods/flats/forgings or rather raw material). 8) Payment Terms - 100% Payment on delivery and acceptance of material at factory premises, which c an be accepted. In such cases, payment is to be made within 45 days of receipt and acceptance of materia ls at the factory premises along with requisite/relevant documents from suppliers. 9) NOTE - Supply orders where the GST amount shall exceed ₹5,000/-, the invoices should be uploaded i mmediately by the supplier in his GSTR-1 / IFF so that the invoice appears in GSTR-2B of the branches, if n ot found in GSTR-2B of the branches, payment should be withheld unless it so appears in the GSTR-2B of t he branches. 10) The Seller/Supplier shall generate and upload the GeM Invoice along with the applicable GST Invoice on the GeM portal at the time of dispatch of the material, for each consignment/supply. 11) Liquidated damages, Force majeure clause shall be applicable as per GeM GTC. 12) Arbitration clause shall be applicable as per YILSPM-2024 clause no 3.26. 13) In case of any query, email to ofapv@ord.gov.in. .
